{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Psi 1''''' was a [[Class-A cargo container]] carrying [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]] bound for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Warrior (Star Destroyer)|''Warrior'']] over [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] during the Galactic Empire's [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. It was fruitlessly scanned for [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] by [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] during the [[Rescue at Mon Calamari]], later [[Flight simulator/Legends|simulated]] by the Alliance as a training mission for [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].<ref name="XW">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref>
